dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the wide mid-body section toward a pointed posterior peduncle, creating a streamlined triangular 2D profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth and symmetrical without visible localized bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity light grey across the dorsal plane consistent with an adult phenotype.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; surface is predominantly uniform white with minor diffuse grey shading toward the lateral edges.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, prominent, dark longitudinal linear mark located centrally on the dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible linear topological disruption/depression along the central dorsal axis coinciding with a dark pigmented scar.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark, longitudinal scar or deep lesion running vertically along the center of the dorsal surface.
